unappliedCandidate.description: Three sequential parameterized transaction-local scope-setting calls become one parameterized SELECT with the same independent keys, values and local=true.
unchanged: Workspace, canvas and source lock order
Fresh session, role, license, grant and expiry checks
Stream/client cadences, recovery and authority deadlines
Object, document, editor and guest limits

protocol.change: Three independent transaction-local scope settings in selectBoard: sequential statements to one parameterized SELECT.
protocol.pilotNote: Before lint-only unit mock cleanup; production browser, server and harness source unchanged. A new build with current full source provenance is required for confirming pairs. Keep pilot observations disclosed.
protocol.acceptance: Every completed run retained, including failed gates. No dropped profiling samples for direct-query count comparison. Distinguish direct operation statement counts from total workload SQL and latency. Expand equally instrumented comparisons if observed tail regression is unresolved.
protocol.extensionReason: First off pair improved peer p95 but raised acknowledgement p95 by5.1 percent. Reverse-order off pair checks whether a consistent acknowledgement regression is observed; retain every outcome and unchanged gates.

workload.pacing: Concurrent independent-object waves; each wave waits for every HTTP acknowledgement and peer paint opportunity before its successor

environment.apiNodeMode: NODE_ENV=test production route implementations, relaxed global loopback IP budget; not a production deployment

environmentNotes: Local headless Chromium and native Node coordinator; PostgreSQL and Valkey in the same existing Colima VM.
Container tags postgres:17-alpine and valkey/valkey:8-alpine. cacheVersion is the Redis-compatible version reported by INFO, not the Valkey release number.
All heavy checks, builds and browser trials ran serially; user containers and VM allocation were unchanged.

measurementDefinitions.httpAcknowledgement: Browser performance.now immediately before authenticated fetch to after response JSON/receipt validation; includes browser-emulated latency and HTTP/auth/repository/projection costs
measurementDefinitions.repositoryResolutionToPeerPaintOpportuni: One coordinator monotonic clock: command repository promise resolution after its transaction returns, to an authorized different-node observer binding after matching on-screen SVG text and two requestAnimationFrames. Includes CDP binding delivery; an upper bound on a paint opportunity, not database COMMIT instant or physical pixel/monitor latency
measurementDefinitions.guestPublication: Same resolution-to-two-rAF observation for an ordinary private object explicitly published by the facilitator; measured in the Bearer-only guest canvas served by the other node
measurementDefinitions.initialRender: Browser navigation performance.now to expected complete SVG object count and visible authorized text plus two requestAnimationFrames; sequential fresh browser contexts, server/OS caches warm after the first navigation
measurementDefinitions.navigationFrameInterval: Consecutive browser rAF timestamps while real pointer hand-pan gestures cross the already-rendered mixed scene; not presented-frame GPU timing or reference-device FPS
measurementDefinitions.reconnect: Coordinator time from enabling the offline peer context network until both its latest authorized matching text plus two rAF and a new stream request
measurementDefinitions.stalledConsumerAcknowledgement: HTTP acknowledgement samples while an additional authorized raw TCP stream deliberately does not consume its response body; checks isolation, not a forced worst-case backpressure cutoff
measurementDefinitions.repositoryProfiling: Optional CANVAS_COLLAB_PROFILE=true instance/SQL/pool observations during measured write-and-peer-paint waves only; setup/warm-up and operations begun before that window are excluded. Monotonic client elapsed times, numeric correlation and fixed method/SQL categories only. CANVAS_COLLAB_PROFILE_MAX_SAMPLES bounds retained completions (default20000,max100000); truncation and in-flight observations are disclosed. No authority cache or production behavior changes; gates remain independent.

provenanceNotes: The first baseline pilot is retained, including its timing. A lint-only unit mock cleanup changed the browser source fingerprint before a fresh confirming build; production browser, server and harness code did not change.
All six confirming runs use the same production browser build provenance. Each API variant is started in a fresh process from hash-checked source; ports must be closed before switching.
Raw reports, traces and numeric samples remain local. This summary includes every complete timing run, including failed smoke gates.

initialCandidateRestrictedPostgres.failure: Existing full-state comparison assumed stable object-array order after redo.

functionalValidation.orderAssertionCorrection: Fixed IDs make reload order differences deterministic. Sort copies of only objects arrays before exact whole-board equality; every field, duplicate/count, metadata, permission and actor-owned uppercase history head remains checked. No production ordering change.
functionalValidation.poolIsolationRegression: One nonprivileged physical connection with forced RLS, scopes A-B-A across two organizations, commit and rollback, no unscoped rows after release, committed title persists and rolled-back title does not.
functionalValidation.startupAttemptExcluded: An initial isolated test failed to connect while the disposable PostgreSQL service was restarting after initialization. TCP readiness was corrected before every accepted conformance or capacity run; no timing report existed for that attempt.

interpretation: The fixed measured paths save two direct statements per authorize, four per get, and six per command. Both owner and other-editor distributions confirm the counts; this is not a total-system SQL percentage or guaranteed latency win.

Reject the candidate: acknowledgement p95 is higher in both profiling-disabled comparisons, despite lower peer p95 and fewer statements. Keep the patch unapplied, preserve the regression tests, and continue staging qualification before limits change.
The second baseline failed both acknowledgement gates at 2,039 ms. They use the same acknowledgement samples under the stalled-reader condition and are not independent failures.
All completed workloads passed their correctness assertions. No failed timing result was discarded and no gate, limit, actor count, pacing or deadline was relaxed.
limitations: Localhost, two serving API nodes in ONE coordinator process/monotonic clock; no separate hosts, reverse proxy/TLS, WAN, OS network shaping, or independently skewed clocks
Production Next build and headless desktop Chromium on the current machine, not a deployed production API configuration or reference mobile/physical touch device
CDP nominal latency applies to browser network requests; actual measured health-fetch calibration is reported; local Node setup/correctness requests are not shaped
Tiny synthetic PNG bytes and in-memory storage.readImage replace S3/scanner/full-size decoding; no production media pipeline or realistic image memory claim
SVG DOM and two animation frames establish a paint opportunity, not physical display capture timing; screenshots verify representative output only

Short burst/wave workload with a single observing peer, unsaturated comments/history/receipts and a single guest; no long-duration soak, worst-case moderation/facilitation saturation, or all-to-all peer latency matrix
Stalled TCP consumer isolation does not establish saturation/backpressure cutoff unless observed; API nodes and Chromium contend for this host's resources
Only one profiled comparison and two off pairs plus the retained baseline pilot; no statistical confidence or production latency guarantee is claimed.
Profiles censor work crossing the measured-window end; disclose in-flight counts. Nested method wall times overlap; direct query counts belong to their innermost operation.
Total query counts depend on stream/read work completed during each measured window and cannot be subtracted as fixed-workload savings.
Guest publication and reconnect each have one observation per run. Literal 16.7 ms rAF quantiles reflect timestamp quantization, not physical 60 fps proof.
The 500 ms peer roadmap target remains unmet. Physical devices, realistic media/scanner/S3, target staging topology/TLS and long saturation/all-to-all work remain open.
